summary: This Form 8-K filed by Solstice Advanced Materials Inc. announces a quarterly dividend declaration of $0.075 per share, payable September 10, 2026, to holders of record August 27, 2026. The filing is a routine dividend announcement that does not constitute a special situation; it lacks any terms indicative of a capital return program or extraordinary distribution. No price, premium, or structural mechanics beyond the regular quarterly dividend are provided. Investors should view this as a standard current report with no special-situation implications.
